### Which file do I need?

| File | Use it for |
|---|---|
| **livepull.zip** | Installing on your sites from GitHub. Tells you when there's an update. |
| **livepull-wordpress-org.zip** | Submitting to the WordPress.org plugin directory only (no self-updater, as WordPress.org requires). |
| wp-sync.zip | Only for sites still running the old "WP Sync" name. |

The `.sha256` files are checksums the plugin uses to check its updates.
